explanation: The values spiral inward-out from 1 to 9.
Equal neighbours do not form an increasing step.
1 and 2 are diagonal, so the best path has 2 cells.
matrix[i][j] = i + j has exponentially many monotone paths: unmemoised DFS explodes.
Every monotone staircase is increasing: brute force cannot enumerate them.
One path through all 10^4 cells: deep recursion.
